title: Library with 12 products
summary: Priya's Library at twelve products: the display h1, a calmer attention shelf (one card, two items, only the most urgent with a solid action), a toolbar with search (⌘K), counted chips, sort and Grid/List, and compact tiles (16:9 art or the flat tint, icon, name, tier, one outlined quick action). The Missing a license? strip stays.
compare: The attention shelf is one card; only its most urgent item (Diceroll on 3 of 3 devices) has a solid action, the rest are outlined (B12, portal-17). A full license reads neutral (DL6).
Toolbar: search with ⌘K, counted chips (All 12 selected, Updates, Games, Apps), sort, Grid/List as a segmented switch.

Compact tiles: 16:9 art (the product's art or its stored flat tint, never a gradient), the icon over its lower edge, name once, the tier pill, one outlined quick action and More; four up at desktop, two at tablet, one on a phone.
No product name painted over art; status plates at the bottom-left of the art on a narrow compact tile (PORTAL §7).
The Missing a license? strip stays at the end; the bottom bar on a phone.
